description: Capabilities for the extension-tool popup (pet-panel machinery: floats over every app/Space). Needs window drag/maximize/hide (pet-panel-style titlebar with pin/fullscreen/close buttons), focus events for the unpinned blur-auto-hide, and the extension-tool lifecycle commands. The built-in translation popup renders React content instead of an iframe: it opens external links via the opener plugin (same grant pet-panel carries). Translation prefs persist through the pet://settings-updated broadcast → main-window hydrateAllStores → quit-time persistNow() flush (secondary windows have no fs grant; the main window is the single disk writer) — NO fs permissions needed.
